name: APIVerveStreetAddressParser
summary: Street Address Parser is an address parsing API that breaks raw US street addresses into structured location components.
description:
Street Address Parser is an address parsing API that breaks raw US street addresses into structured location components. Pass any single-line address string to extract the building number, street name, street type, city, state abbreviation, and postal code.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Street Address Parser from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
